scripts.build: yarn workspace @zupre/room-card run build && yarn workspace @zupre/printer-card run build && yarn workspace @zupre/forecast-card run build
scripts.watch: yarn workspace @zupre/room-card run watch & yarn workspace @zupre/printer-card run watch & yarn workspace @zupre/forecast-card run watch & wait
scripts.test: yarn workspace @zupre/core run test; s1=$?; yarn workspace @zupre/printer-card run test; s2=$?; yarn workspace @zupre/forecast-card run test; s3=$?; exit $((s1 || s2 || s3))
